tokens.name: sage-900
tokens.usage: Deepest step of the sage ladder; reserve for the darkest panels.

tokens.name: sage-800
tokens.usage: Dark green panel step between `sage-900` and `sage-700`.

tokens.name: sage-700
tokens.usage: Official deep green: display text, dark panels and the pressed state of actions. Reads 6.6:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: sage-600
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of sage actions; the focus ring.

tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: Official primary sage: buttons, links, active affordances, logo tone on paper. White text on it is 2.8:1, so keep text on sage large or bold.

tokens.name: sage-400
tokens.usage: Mid sage for hairline accents and the `thread-sage` line.

tokens.name: sage-300
tokens.usage: Light sage steps for borders on sage surfaces and soft fills.

tokens.name: sage-200
tokens.usage: Light sage steps for borders on sage surfaces and soft fills.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Pale sage surface tint for panels (`surface-sage`).

tokens.name: sage-50
tokens.usage: Faintest sage wash for feature panels.

tokens.name: stone-600
tokens.usage: Stone-grey, darker step; source of `ink-500` (secondary text).

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Official stone-grey neutral; the other allowed logo tone besides white and sage.

tokens.name: stone-300
tokens.usage: Light stone steps for dividers and quiet fills.

tokens.name: stone-100
tokens.usage: Light stone steps for dividers and quiet fills.

tokens.name: sand-500
tokens.usage: Official sand / tan; the `thread-sand` line and warm accents on paper.

tokens.name: sand-300
tokens.usage: Lighter sand steps; `sand-100` is the sand surface (`surface-sand`).

tokens.name: sand-100
tokens.usage: Lighter sand steps; `sand-100` is the sand surface (`surface-sand`).

tokens.name: linen-500
tokens.usage: Official light stone for neutral fields and borders.

tokens.name: linen-300
tokens.usage: Lighter light-stone steps for quiet backgrounds.

tokens.name: linen-100
tokens.usage: Lighter light-stone steps for quiet backgrounds.

tokens.name: clay-600

tokens.name: clay-500
tokens.usage: Kraft brown for the CBD Care sub-line.

tokens.name: clay-300
tokens.usage: Mid kraft tint for borders on kraft pills.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primary page background: warm off-white, never stark.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Official white: product photography ground, card surface and white logo/text.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Official deep green as text: headings and primary text on `paper` (6.6:1) and `cloud` (7.2:1). No near-black anywhere in the brand.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `cloud` (4.9:1); on `paper` it is 4.4:1, just under 4.5:1, kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Muted/faint text and placeholders. Only 3.0:1 on `paper` and 3.3:1 on `cloud`: keep to large or non-essential text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: accent-mauve
tokens.usage: Accent, official PMS 624. Use sparingly, for balance and focus only; also the `thread-mauve` line.

tokens.name: accent-pink
tokens.usage: Accent, official PMS 707. Use sparingly; also the `thread-pink` line.

tokens.name: accent-berry
tokens.usage: Deepest accent, official PMS 506. Sale flags and the danger colour. Use sparingly.

tokens.usage: Legacy packaging "thread": the single diagonal hairline on each pack. Hairline accents only, never fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status; same green as `ink-900`. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger status; same berry as `accent-berry`. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: surface-green-deep
tokens.usage: Deep green panels; `text-on-sage` reads 7.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-photo
tokens.usage: Ground behind product photography: pure white.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on `surface-page` (6.6:1), `surface-card` (7.2:1) and `surface-sage` (6.1:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-card` (4.9:1); on `surface-page` 4.4:1, just under 4.5:1, kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary meta; 3.0:1 on `surface-page` and 3.3:1 on `surface-card`, so not for essential small text. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: text-on-sage
tokens.usage: White text on `surface-green-deep` (7.2:1). On `surface-sage-deep`/`action` it is 2.8:1, below 4.5:1: kept exact from the source, so use it only for large or bold text there.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows and brand text on `surface-page` (6.6:1) and `surface-sage` (6.1:1).

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Default hairline border on cards and inputs.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (sage): buttons, active controls.

tokens.name: action-contrast
tokens.usage: Text on `action`; white is 2.8:1 on sage, kept exact from the source. Use bold or large text, or `surface-green-deep`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour: 4.3:1 on `surface-page` and 4.7:1 on `surface-card`. Kept exact from the source; `shadow-focus` adds a soft halo.

tokens.name: brand-sage
tokens.usage: Brand mark colour: sage, one of the three allowed logo tones.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Brand deep green for text and dark panels.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink; the deep green, not black.

styles.name: editorial

tokens.usage: Smallest corner: tags and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small corners: inline chips and thumbnails.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Default card shadow: soft, green-tinted, low opacity.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
